title: SAP Releases Urgent Patches for Critical Vulnerabilities in Multiple Products
description:
On August 12, 2026, SAP issued 30 security notes addressing four critical vulnerabilities with CVSS scores up to 10/10. These flaws primarily affect SAP Commerce Cloud, Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence, and Application Server ABAP. The vulnerabilities could allow remote code execution, unauthorized access, and sensitive data disclosure. Engineering teams are advised to apply the patches immediately to mitigate these risks. The vulnerabilities were confirmed on the same day as the patch release, emphasizing the urgency of the situation. Organizations using the affected systems are at significant risk if they fail to update promptly.

Key Points:
• SAP released 30 security notes addressing four critical vulnerabilities.
• CVSS scores for these vulnerabilities reach up to 10/10, indicating severe risk.
• Immediate patching is required to prevent remote code execution and data theft.
